profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | FinTech | Distributed Systems | API & Microservices Design | Java, Python, Kafka, AWS, GraphQL
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer with over 5 years of experience in financial services technology, specializing in backend development, distributed systems, and high-volume APIs.

At BNY Mellon, I’ve led the design and migration of legacy mainframe systems into event-driven microservices that process 100M+ weekly transactions, and architected GraphQL APIs serving ~255M calls per week with sub-second latency. My work spans Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, AWS, Oracle, GraphQL, and Apache Ignite, with a strong emphasis on security, scalability, and performance.

Beyond coding, I thrive in mentorship and collaboration — reviewing code, leading POCs for new technologies, and helping teams adopt best practices in CI/CD, observability, and secure engineering. 
Recently, I’ve also contributed to AI-driven observability tools, applying machine learning to improve log analysis and operational insights.

I’m passionate about building systems that are not only scalable and resilient, but also move the business forward. Always open to connecting with fellow engineers, leaders, and innovators in FinTech, APIs, and distributed systems.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Led the migration from mainframe systems to event-driven microservices, processing 100M+ weekly transactions with Java, Kafka, AWS, and Oracle.
- Architected GraphQL APIs handling ~255M calls per week with sub-second latency, leveraging Apache Ignite for in-memory caching.
- Strengthened security with JWT authentication and fine-grained entitlements, ensuring compliance across datasets.
- Improved observability by building monitoring pipelines with Splunk and Grafana.
- Managed CI/CD pipelines (GitLab, Docker, SonarQube) including rollback automation for Oracle schema changes.
- Mentored junior engineers, conducted code reviews, and drove adoption of best practices.
- Delivered POCs on emerging technologies (e.g., Ignite 3 migration, API rate limiting) that influenced production adoption.
- Contributed to AI-driven observability tools (ODS Tech Assistant) to improve log analysis and incident response.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Trained on in-demand programming skills for both front-end and back-end software development.
- Led development from requirements gathering to launch on several projects, including reimbursement
request system, a medical clinic appointment scheduler and a search engine web application.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed Java-based microservices and REST APIs for customer accounts, onboarding, and transaction systems.
• Built integrations with Oracle and PostgreSQL to support real-time account data across web and mobile platforms.
• Modernized legacy systems into Spring Boot microservices, improving maintainability and scalability.
• Implemented Kafka event streams for transaction notifications and inter-service communication.
• Strengthened security with Spring Security, JWT, and OAuth2 authentication.
• Supported CI/CD automation and code quality enforcement using GitLab, Jenkins, and SonarQube.
• Collaborated in Agile teams to deliver customer-facing features efficiently and securely.
